shots.content: Fair-skinned woman in cream pyjamas at night holding the Professor Jar mascot (glasses) next to her face; small cartoon dark-spot / dullness faces stuck on her cheek.

shots.note: Jar and label are correct, no skin, no woman, cartoon ingredients are fine. Matches L2 'Three concerns. Three specialists.'

shots.content: Macro of the fair woman's cheek (freckle-dot spots) with the golden Kojic Acid character attacking cartoon dark-spot faces.

shots.content: Silver Niacinamide character sweeping a grey dullness cloud off the woman's blurred skin.
shots.note: S4 and S5 become one continuous 2.57 s run of KNA2 (8.1-10.67). Start the clip about 1.5 s in so the icy white-blue orb is rising under the NIACINAMIDE pill and the pink orb under the ALPHA ARBUTIN pill. The clip has no baked text.

shots.content: Close-up of the fair woman's cheek with the pink Alpha Arbutin character holding a two-tone patch.
shots.note: Continues the KNA2 clip from S4 (pink orb rising). Alpha Arbutin used to appear with no line; the new L4 now says 'Three: even-looking tone' here.

shots.content: Fair woman at night applying cream to her cheek with her fingertips, holding the open jar.
shots.note: L5 'Now apply at night, and let the team get to work' plays over ANANYA applying at night and massaging until the cream is fully absorbed with no residue (2.93 s).

shots.content: AI before/after split of the fair woman with dotty spots on BOTH halves; baked 'After 2 Weeks / DERMDOC KNC'.
shots.note: Vertical half/half: KN08_before_day (left) and KN07_after_day (right), faces not cropped, BEFORE under the left half and AFTER 2 WEEKS under the right. Plays under the narrator's brand line.
